title: hieracium longiradiatum
intro: Hieracium longiradiatum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium longiradiatum include wound healing, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential.
